name: Aiod CLI
description: Remote control for the aiod v2 API inside a CubeSandbox: process execution, file management, browser and MCP.
whenToUse: Run commands, manage files, drive the browser, execute code or start an MCP server inside a CubeSandbox.

aiod_version.description: Show aiod-cli version and platform; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

aiod_health.description: Check the in-sandbox aiod service health; returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

/properties/base.description: Sandbox gateway URL; defaults to SANDBOX_BASE from settings.

aiod_run.description: Run an aiod-cli command (exec, files, pty, browser, misc...); returns { stdout, stderr, exitCode }.

/properties/cmd.description: Subcommand name, e.g. exec, ls, cat, write, upload, download, browser.

/properties/base.description: Gateway URL of a specific sandbox instance.

aiod_submit.description: Submit a long-running sandbox task asynchronously; returns { taskId, cmd, status, message }.

aiod_log.description: Read logs of a task submitted by aiod_submit; returns { taskId, status, completed, exitCode, logs, nextOffset, totalLines }.

/properties/offset.description: Line index to start reading from; defaults to the beginning.

aiod_kill.description: Terminate a running async sandbox task; returns { taskId, killed }.
